rows.routeSelectionsMadeDetail: This form carries no route fork. Its eight ground boxes look like one and are not: the single route spans all eight and the route-obligation census records its basis as a record created on one of the eight statutory grounds without naming one. All eight, and the four court-department boxes, are declared REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with determinedByTheCaseNotTheRoute and a stated reason.
contradictsARecordInThisRepo: SOURCE_READY_BUILDABILITY.json classes this family SOURCE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED with documentSourcesResolved 0, and the MASTER_QUEUE row repeats the scalar as custodyClass SOURCE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED — in the same row that reads sourceStatus SOURCE_BOUND_BY_HELD_BYTES, sourceBound true, and pins the exact digest that binds. The buildability row per-source entry for this very source reads kind held_pdf, firstBytes %PDF- and resolvedBy declared_path. The row contradicts its own scalar and the scalar is the wrong half.

data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/pf23/rows.json, written by the previous PF23 worker, returns this family STOPPED / BLOCKED_SOURCE on the ground that no digest is pinned for this label anywhere. MASTER_QUEUE.json pins 19842819786d812c82c0b310aed8a5065e516a95122a59e0662a7ca67159a5ce for it in sourceHashes, and that prior row records the same worker re-hashing the same file to the same digest. The stop was on a record that disagreed with the queue own pin.

SOURCE_IDENTITY_RESOLUTION_SWEEP.json records identityEvidence.xfaPresent false for these bytes. The AcroForm dictionary of the pinned binary carries an /XFA entry and pdf-lib announces removing XFA form data on load. The binary is an XFA hybrid; its AcroForm side is complete and the delivered artifact is the flattened rendering of the static pages. The same disagreement was measured on TC0021 by ma-expunge-mj-set, so it is a property of how that field is generated rather than of this file.
measurementsWorthCarrying: Every check box on this form ships a /1 appearance and NO /Off. That is the precondition of the measured Vermont synthesized-border defect: without suppression, twenty-two unticked boxes would each acquire a stroked square this court form does not print. Both suppression flags are passed and all twenty-two rectangles are read in the output on the ink-operator channel to confirm nothing paints there.

Ink must be measured by operator SEMANTICS, not by operator census. Every text field on this binary ships no /AP, so pdf-lib generates one, and each generated appearance is a path-construction-and-clip preamble around an EMPTY <> Tj. Counting the preamble as painting flagged 22 clean boxes and 7 clean text fields; counting Tj by operator rather than by operand flagged the 7 again. Both readings inflated visualDefects, the counter that would have stopped a correct packet. The builder now counts stroke/fill/shading/XObject operators apart from path and clip operators, and reads show-text by its operand.

A quoted anchor must be a whole sentence. This form instruction sheet wraps its sentences over three and four lines, and quoting the single extracted line an anchor sat on handed the participant a fragment beginning mid-clause as the court own words. Quoted anchors now name a span of printed lines, are assembled in reading order and cut at a sentence boundary, and the assembled quotation is asserted to end on a terminator and still contain its needle.

Page 1 prints DATE: and PETITIONER SIGNATURE on a rule and the AcroForm carries no widget at either. No field counter would ever have shown that gap; the participant is told the rule has no fillable box and is signed by hand.

contradictsARecordInThisRepo: SOURCE_READY_BUILDABILITY.json and the MASTER_QUEUE row class this family custodyClass SOURCE_GENUINELY_MISSING with documentSourcesResolved 0, in the same rows that read sourceStatus SOURCE_BOUND_BY_HELD_BYTES, sourceBound true, kind held_pdf, firstBytes %PDF- and resolvedBy declared_path for this very source. GENUINELY_MISSING is the strongest thing that record can say about a source and it was said about a file in custody the whole time, at the exact digest the queue itself pins.

SOURCE_IDENTITY_RESOLUTION_SWEEP.json records identityEvidence.xfaPresent false for these bytes. The AcroForm dictionary carries /XFA and pdf-lib removes an XFA packet on load. Third Massachusetts Trial Court binary measured with the same wrong scalar (with ma-expunge-k-set here and TC0021 in ma-expunge-mj-set), which makes it a property of how that field is generated rather than of any one file.
measurementsWorthCarrying: THE ACROFORM INDEX ORDER DOES NOT FOLLOW THE PRINTED ROW ORDER OF THIS FORM 37-ROW CHARGE TABLE. 52 of the 111 cells carry an index that disagrees with the row number printed beside them: printed row 5 is TextField3[6] / DropDownList1[9] / DateField1[7]; printed row 13 is TextField3[12] / DropDownList1[1] / DateField1[12]. A builder that took a row number from a field index would label a cell for one charge and place it on another charge line, on a petition signed under a perjury warning, and every field counter would read clean because the cell count and the label count would both be right. Every cell row here is resolved by GEOMETRY against the printed number and the build refuses if any cell matches none or more than one. Any family whose form carries a numbered table needs the same check.

THE COLUMN ORDER CANNOT BE READ OFF THE EXTRACTED LINES. The five header lines interleave — Charge Date of Nolle Prosequi or is one extracted line — and read naively they put the date in the middle column. By item x-position the middle heading is State Whether the Court Entered a Nolle Prosequi or Dismissed the Charge and the right heading is Date of Nolle Prosequi or Dismissal. Two independent readings are asserted: the heading item positions, and the middle widget own option list, read from the binary as Nolle Prosequi / Dismissed. The naive reading would have told the participant to write a date in the box that asks which disposition the court entered.

A REQUIRED-BEFORE-FILING ITEM IS DISCLOSED BY NAME OR IT IS NOT DISCLOSED. The first pass described the charge table by its three columns once — which is how the form presents it and how a person reads it — and the completeness contract counted all 111 cells as requiredFactsNotCollected, correctly: the three columns, repeated names no blank. Pointing at a JSON report would not have fixed it either; the participant does not read the build reports. The instructions now carry every one of the 111 blanks by name, one line per numbered row.

The COURT ORDER block on page 2 prints a hearing date, a hearing time and a JUSTICE SIGNATURE and DATE line, and the AcroForm carries no widget at any of them. Its only widget is one check box, refused as court-owned on the block own printed caption.
